title: Disconnect from Wi-Fi network
summary: Closes the current Wi-Fi connection on the specified interface.

steps.explain: Disconnects the specified wireless interface from the current network.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of your wireless interface, e.g., wlan0

steps.expect: The interface disconnects from the network.

rollback.explain: Reconnect to the network using your usual method (e.g., NetworkManager GUI or iw connect).

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of your wireless interface, e.g., wlan0

placeholders.name: SSID
placeholders.description: The name of the Wi-Fi network

warnings: You will lose internet access until you reconnect.
